typicalChallenges: How are API consumers authenticated and authorised, and how are tokens managed?
What input validation is applied to prevent injection attacks through integration points?
How is sensitive data protected in transit between systems, including within the internal network?
What rate limiting and throttling prevents abuse of exposed APIs?
How will you monitor the health of all integration points and detect failures quickly?
What happens when a downstream dependency becomes unavailable — does the service degrade gracefully?
How are integration errors investigated and resolved across organisational boundaries?
What is the on-call burden for maintaining integrations with external systems?
How will you test integrations when dependent systems are not available in lower environments?
What is the API versioning strategy and how will breaking changes be communicated to consumers?
How are integration contracts defined and validated (contract testing, schema validation)?
What is the lead time for establishing new integrations with external parties?
What are the per-transaction costs for third-party API calls at projected volumes?
Are there licensing costs for integration middleware or API management platforms?
What is the cost of maintaining bespoke integrations versus using standard platforms?
How do integration costs scale if transaction volumes increase significantly?
